### Data Analyst

<div class="experience-organization">

[BioStone Animal Health LLC](https://biostoneah.com/)

</div>

- Contributed to the development of an ELISA assay data analysis
  application through requirements definition, feature design, analytical
  output validation, project coordination, and user-feedback analysis.

- Collected, consolidated, and analyzed laboratory batch-testing data in
  Excel to evaluate diagnostic kit performance and prepare quality-control
  reports.

- Redesigned the company's quality-control reporting template,
  establishing a standardized format that continued to be used for
  subsequent product batches.

- Organized and tracked production and order data across diagnostic kit
  assembly, fulfillment, and distribution, and developed standard
  operating procedures to improve workflow consistency.

- Collaborated with laboratory, production, business, and international
  teams, including offices in Turkey and Guangzhou, to support product
  development and cross-regional operations.

- Built and maintained the company's website using WordPress and HTML,
  and revised product instructions to improve technical accuracy and
  usability.
